subject.title: refactor: canonicalize correctness-critical UI and channel contracts

question: Should this maintainer-owned umbrella remain the canonical tracker while the linked Workboard and channel-status PRs are reviewed, or should maintainers split the remaining Control UI gateway contract work into a narrower issue now?
rationale: The issue crosses security-sensitive status output plus Gateway/plugin/UI ownership boundaries, and current open PRs only settle slices of the final contract direction.

options.title: Keep The Umbrella Through Staged PRs
options.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination point until the linked Workboard and channel-status PRs land or are rejected, then resolve the remaining Control UI gateway slice.

options.title: Split Gateway UI Work Now
options.body: Create a narrower maintainer-owned issue for the remaining Control UI gateway frame/payload contract and keep this issue open only until all context is linked there.

options.title: Pause Until PR Outcomes
options.body: Hold new work until maintainers decide whether the two open PRs establish the correct seams for the broader cleanup.

recommendation.title: Keep The Umbrella Through Staged PRs
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination point until the linked Workboard and channel-status PRs land or are rejected, then resolve the remaining Control UI gateway slice.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the umbrella issue and authored the staged implementation-candidate PRs.
